Accrued general-law compensation/travel liabilities do not perpetuate committee authority.

research_rationale: The frozen dossier supplies ACTOR_TEXT:EO:13033 and ACTOR_TEXT:EO:13034 despite retaining machine missing-provision warnings. EO13033 concerns pay schedules and supersedes only EO12984/12990 in the held operative text; the blank extracted schedules do not supply a committee-ending lead. EO13034 section 2(b)(2) expressly states the original Final Report was submitted December 31, 1996, resolving the old factual gap for that report. Its January 30, 1997 extension preserves membership, administration, limitations and appointments while adding oversight/evaluation functions. Section 3(a), however, makes the extended Committee terminate 30 days after submitting its final supplemental report. The October 31, 1997 date in section 2(e) is only its deadline; the actual supplemental-report submission date is absent. Thus neither January 30, 1997 from the original trigger nor November 30, 1997 computed from a deadline can be asserted as the Committee’s final earliest cessation after extension. EO13138 confirms prior termination and revokes the amended order on September 30, 1999, without establishing the supplemental-report trigger date. No independent continuing committee duty is saved; general accrued claims cannot fill the missing first-end evidence.
unresolved_material_gaps: Actual submission date of the final supplemental report required by EO13034 is absent; apply its section 3(a) 30-day termination trigger only after establishing that date. The October 31, 1997 reporting deadline does not establish submission.
